overview: This unit covers programming fundamentals using C++ and SplashKit library. Key concepts include variables, functions, loops, conditional statements, data structures, pointers, and game development. All tasks completed to High Distinction level demonstrating mastery of procedural programming concepts.

projects.title: Hello World

This foundational task helped understand how basic coding works in C++ and verified that the C++ compiler (clang++), SplashKit manager (skm), and all components are functioning properly.
